arms.label: real agent-5, cc files restored and --no-fail-fast

claims.fix_tested: old vs --no-fail-fast, same files: agent-1 1.4711 -> 1.7461, auto-8 8.5443 -> 8.7683, agent-5 17.1997 -> 17.2997; with cc files restored agent-5 27.1706 -> 27.5980

claims.claim: Four missing cc files block nine scored crates.
claims.witness: real unchanged: agent-5; synthetic: reference (upstream CAS v1.0.0 bodies, hidden tests removed); starter as the no-work control
claims.fix_tested: old vs build_vendor.py writing the 4 files (checksums match 4 of 4), same files: agent-5 17.1997 -> 27.1706, reference 27.6091 -> 73.9926, starter 1.4711 -> 3.8189
claims.correct_work_keeps_score: yes: all rise, agent-5 by 9.97 and the reference by 46.38, while the no-work starter gains only 2.35
claims.note: No blind spot here: no real run beats the block (best archived 17.20, NOTES' historical best 27.37, a complete solution 27.61 as shipped); weakest point: upstream already documents this as Known issue 1 and keeps it for comparability, arms ran at 8 vCPU with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 (old-judge scores equal the official 4 CPU ones), and cas-search and cas-cli still fail to compile with the files restored, capping the reference at 73.99.
